Generated from assembly-dcmi.yml and profile-status.yml of FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification at commit 1e6d692a37 — SHA-256 096b9cf85f14a111dfaa3889319b112f3053f73b5247440a9cf9cbd0e73d610c and b19aa901c129a458ed64bc485d02d9fe5a472626a662d925ab43bd3f9f2bf38a — retrieved 2026-11-14. Profile version 0.1.0-draft.1, upstream status proposal. Regenerate and compare with python3 scripts/mapping_crosswalk.py --check, which the site checks run on every pull request. The specification repository stays the authority: this is a rendering of it, not a second definition.

The v1 descriptive surface rules on all 24 root fields of the FHR 2.0 contract — the record scope is assembly — against qualified DCMI Terms 2020-01-20 (the 2020-01-20 versioned page): 9 conditional projections and 15 fields not projected, plus 4 keys that arrive from the supplemental export context instead of from the header. Each row carries its own condition, transformation and loss statement; nothing here is collapsed into an unconditional equivalence.

"Not projected" describes this surface rather than the field: the inventory records why the value is left out of the graph and where it is preserved instead. The RDF graph is not lossless — it drops array order and nested structure — so the source record and the context remain the preservation layer, and Simple DC is not used as an intermediate store.

Supplemental export-context keys

These keys are not FHR fields and add nothing to any header. They let a citation title, publisher, publication date and resource IRI come from an explicit assertion rather than be inferred from the record. The proposed contract is assembly-export-context.schema.json at the same commit, checked offline by scripts/check_mapping_context.py upstream.

One worked bundle, end to end

The v1 surface ships one curated example rather than a generated export: a schema-valid FHR source record, an explicit export context, a hand-written qualified-DC graph, and a report that names what the graph did not carry. Reading the report next to the graph is the point — a descriptive export is judged by what it states and by what it admits it dropped, not by the fact that it parsed.

Curated qualified-DC graph (hand-written fixture, not tool output)

Pinned copy of qualified-dc.ttl, SHA-256 240f5c4f1aeb46ab595fa703c019e0569f8b2dba743a790b5294f5ebdb8ba0e1. Reproduced unchanged; every identifier in it is illustrative.

# Draft descriptive example only. MPL-2.0. All example.org identifiers are illustrative.
@prefix dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix dctype: <http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

<https://example.org/assemblies/synthetic-v1>
    a dctype:Dataset ;
    dcterms:title "Synthetic human reference assembly, version 0.0.1" ;
    dcterms:identifier "https://example.org/assemblies/synthetic-v1" ;
    dcterms:creator [ a dcterms:Agent ; rdfs:label "David Molik" ;
        dcterms:identifier "https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3192-6538" ] ;
    dcterms:publisher [ a dcterms:Agent ; rdfs:label "Example Repository" ;
        dcterms:identifier "https://example.org/repository" ] ;
    dcterms:created "2022-03-21"^^xsd:date ;
    dcterms:issued "2026-02-02"^^xsd:date ;
    dcterms:subject <https://identifiers.org/taxonomy:9606> ;
    dcterms:relation <https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbae122>,
        <http://wfleabase.org/genome/Daphnia_pulex/dpulex_jgi060905/fasta/>,
        <https://example.org/assembly-protocol> ;
    dcterms:rights [ a dcterms:RightsStatement ; rdfs:label "public domain" ] .

<https://example.org/metadata/synthetic-v1>
    a dctype:Text ;
    dcterms:subject <https://example.org/assemblies/synthetic-v1> ;
    dcterms:conformsTo <https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/fhr/v0.4.0> ;
    dcterms:creator [ a dcterms:Agent ; rdfs:label "Adam Wright" ;
        dcterms:identifier "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5719-4024" ] .

Limitations the bundle states about itself:

  • The RDF graph alone does not preserve author/link order, nameType, nested source structures or all domain values; retain source.json and context.json.
  • The graph does not create a resource version relationship from a literal version.
  • Rights text remains a RightsStatement label, not a standardized license assertion.
  • No schema validation of a DOI-agency deposit or actual identifier registration was performed.
  • The source checksum is a placeholder copied from the existing synthetic example; no sequence bytes are provided or verified.

Adoption state of what is shown here

Maintainers adopted this v1 surface as correct-but-not-final on 2026-11-14 and withheld the "official" label until a deterministic exporter ships. That is the dated adoption record. Published fair-bioheaders 0.13.1 now ships the narrow export-dcmi CLI for complete FHR v0.4.0 inputs. Actual installed repeated runs produced identical preservation bundles. This page grants no new official label or expanded profile: it remains reference material, and the worked graph remains a manually curated fixture rather than tool output. The pinned artifacts still carry their own upstream label status: proposal and profile version 0.1.0-draft.1; any version bump, label or re-scoping is recorded on #56, not here. The row-by-row decision sheet is the v1 adoption packet at the pinned commit.
